card.name: And/or joining paired nouns
card.fires_on: The word 'and' or 'or' right after the first of two joined items, such as 'Youth and Family', 'tween or teen', 'Pears, R. and Shields'. The next word is usually a second person, age group or related noun.

modes.label: Paired groups
modes.description: 'and' or 'or' linking two related groups, such as age groups or life areas.
modes.example: Jim is Senior Writer, Editor and Researcher for the HomeWord Center for Youth<< and>> Family at Azusa Pacific University.

modes.label: Citation author lists
modes.description: 'and' between author names in a reference list.
modes.example: referencing and avoiding plagiarism 2nd ed. Maidenhead: Open University Press - Pears, R.<< and>> Shields, G. 201

modes.label: Scripture and list conjunctions
modes.description: 'and' in old-style biblical text or in a list before the last item.
modes.example: helping students gain an advantage in high school, college,<< and>> career.

card.writes: It promotes name-like fragments and suppresses words like 'daughters' and 'dances', so it gives no clear message about what comes next.
card.plain: It fires on 'and' or 'or' when the text is about to name a second, paired item.
